page.overview:
Who is Angel Jin?

Angel Jin is the result of Jin Kazama conquering his Devil Gene and combining its power with that of the Kazama Clan's. He first appeared in Tekken 8's Story Mode after Jin returned to Yakushima and was able to speak with an apparition of his mother. He stops Kazuya from destroying the island, and the two battle fiercely on a falling comet.

Angel Jin's personality remains the same his human counterpart. He is determined to purify the Devil Gene, specifically from Kazuya, ridding the world of its influence.

Angel Jin's body is made of silver armor, including all but his face and a small portion of his neck. His shoulders have tall, pointed ends which open around his trapezius, and the armor over his chest has a glowing gold design which trails down to his lower abdomen. More gold designs appear over the visible portion of his throat, and over his eyebrows, trailing down the sides of his face. His knees have spikes similar to pointed knee pads with golden accents trailing down from his upper thighs, and more gold spikes emerge from his calves. His gauntlets are also spiked at the elbow, glowing gold at the tips, and ending with clawed hands. His hair and horns take on the shape of a helm, covering the bridge of his nose with armor that has a glowing gold arrow leading down to the tip. The back of the helm spikes upwards similar to Devil Jin's normal hairstyle, with gold glowing tips here as well. From the back of his head, there is a plume of gold feathers, and at the front, the helm takes on a horn-like shape with swirling, pointed, feathered armor which also glows gold. In this form, he has golden wings, golden glowing irises, golden eyebrows, and pale gray lips.

Having overcome his inner demons and accepting the Devil Gene within himself, Jin combined both the Devil Gene with the powers of his Kazama blood to transform into Angel Jin, before taking the battle against True Devil Kazuya into space. The pair fight atop a meteor crashing into Earth as it continued to burn upon atmospheric descent. Though True Devil Kazuya would momentarily down Angel Jin, Angel Jin unleashed a purifying field before restraining True Devil Kazuya with purifying chains and dealing a powerful strike to True Devil Kazuya's abdomen.
